content.snl: thm-hyp(list-partial(Type.annotation(@F, Analysis.PFun), Type.annotation(list-partial(@a, @b), Real), $#0 < #1$(a, b), Analysis.contOnIcc(F, a, b)), Logic.exists-typed(@m, Real, Logic.and(Set.mem(m, Icc(a, b)), Analysis.minPoint(F, m))))

values.en: A function continuous on `[a, b]` attains a minimum and a maximum at points of `[a, b]`. Attainment, not merely boundedness, is the content: `x ↦ x` on `(0, 1)` is bounded and attains neither bound, and `x ↦ 1/x` on `(0, 1]` is not even bounded. Boundedness follows as a corollary.
values.zh-CN: 在 `[a, b]` 上连续的函数会在 `[a, b]` 中的点取得最小值和最大值。此处的实质是取得极值，而非仅仅有界：`x ↦ x` 在 `(0, 1)` 上有界但两个界都不取到，而 `x ↦ 1/x` 在 `(0, 1]` 上甚至无界。有界性可作为推论得到。
